title: It’s Time to Run an Audit of All the Cloud Storage Links You’ve Shared
summary: Those old links you shared with friends ages ago are still live, and they might be attracting unwelcome visitors.
llm_summary: Even the oldest cloud‑storage links you sent to friends can stay active forever—meaning anyone who stumbles across them can still download or view your files. Over‑time these lingering URLs become security and privacy risks, especially if the content is sensitive or if the links get indexed by search engines. It’s a good idea to audit and revoke any unused sharing links to keep your data safe.
